district: La Regencia complex + loop road + Madaan St / Mauli St / St 1-2 / Main Chowk / Dewan Hospital core, Ansal Sushant City, Panipat
imagery_vintage: 2023-06 (Google India launch imagery; uniform across all sampled panos; occasional overcast frames are multi-day capture within 2023-06, not a different era)
scope_provenance: Original district ~lat 29.428-29.433, lon 76.984-76.989 plus parent extension: C-Block Rd (N-S @76.9906) and F-Block Rd (E-W @29.4323) east to ~76.9915. Mauli St @29.4272 explicitly retained. South of ~29.427 (A/D Block belt) is the south squad's; northern grid beyond the core is the residential squad's.
naming_source: Google street-name labels from pano metadata (351-pano sample) joined to chains by proximity; OSM has no road names here. Label clusters: C-Block Rd N-S @76.9906 (11 panos), F-Block Rd E-W @29.4323 (8), Millennium School Rd N-S @76.985 (10), La Regencia Rd diagonal (12), Mauli St E-W @29.4272 (4), St 1 @29.4278, St 2 @29.42825, Madaan St @29.4289, St 3 N-S @76.9894, St 4 N-S @76.98996, DPS Jr. St diagonal @76.9863-76.9873, Achievers Point Rd = F-Block Rd alias @76.9885.
method: 573 equirectangular panoramas (zoom3) along 44 pano chains (c0-c37, cE0-cE5) at ~10-20m spacing, reviewed as 96 contact sheets. Every claim carries pano IDs. Chains zigzag; segments split at visual/geometry changes and named from label clusters.

signature_palette.housing: modern plotted builder floors 2-3fl (some 4fl), flat roofs w/ roof-deck railings, brown/grey/cream renders, wood-slat or dark-steel gates, stone/wood cladding accents, checkered or striped paver aprons, hedges/lawns
signature_palette.roads: wide dusty asphalt ~9-12m, interlocking-paver stretches in the W pocket and La Regencia frontage (red pavers), yellow-black painted junction curbs, zebra crossings rare
signature_palette.furniture: concrete transformer poles w/ wire bundles, single-arm curved street lights (double-arm on bigger roads), green utility boxes, guard cabins, occasional blue dumpsters/carts
signature_palette.green: frequent vacant grassy/scrub plots, fenced pocket parks w/ black railings, mature neem/peepal, palms and manicured hedges in upscale belts
signature_palette.construction: active u/c plots scattered throughout (brick stacks, sand piles, blue tarps, bamboo scaffolding)
